title.narrative: Consolidation and evaluation of the Waste to Resources Project and conceptualization of Phase 2

description.narrative: Consolidation and evaluation of the waste to resource project and conceptualization of phase 2 and strengthening of awareness, evidence, and capacities of key stakeholders on the economic and social potential of waste velarization.

This project will support consolidation and evaluation of the ongoing Waste to Resources project funded by Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Sustainable Development of the Government of Grand Duchy of Luxembourg with an eye towards conceptualizing phase 2 of the project, based on robust data, matured business models, as well as enhanced stakeholder awareness and capacities. It will pave the way towards securing a second phase for this flagship project which is currently entering its final year of implementation.
